test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All flats are villas.

No villa is an apartment.

Conclusions:

(I) No flat is an apartment.

(II) No apartment is a villa.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29efcdb2060281eab1e4b667e9a586e84b7b04edab6c645cb02c1aa91c33c1a1.png] 

Conclusions:**
(I) No flat is an apartment. - True (No villa is an apartment, and all flat is an apartment. Hence, it is true).

(II) No apartment is a villa. - True (No villa is an apartment, and all flat is an apartment. Hence, it is true).

Both conclusions, I and II, follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
